title: Ladies Cigar Event | Ugly Christmas Sweater Edition
seo_title: Ladies Cigar Event: Ugly Christmas Sweater Edition
description: This Ladies Cigar Event has a holiday twist, with Padron Cigars, Kevin's Cocktails, and festive fun in the lounge; ugly Christmas sweaters are encouraged. It is for ladies, and tickets are $45, with reservations by phone at (417) 882-0399 or online. It takes place Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
